verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager and build system with an ecosystem (binary caches, remote builds), so event-subscription webhooks are a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents nothing about registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The probes found no API surface at all: no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
